checks.measured: deep: mu_2(x)/x - 1 max 7.5e-03 over x <= 1e-2; Newtonian: mu_2(1e8) = 1.00000000
checks.reading: deep-MOND slope one gives g = sqrt(g_N a_0) with a_0 = s/2, the parameter-free footing; the kernel is fixed with no shape freedom

checks.name: V2 [the validated solver reproduces the exact spherical first integral for THIS kernel] mu_2(g) g = 1/r^2 is solved and compared with the analytic first integral
checks.measured: max relative error 5.878e-04 over the fit range (17 iters, resid 7.7e-11)
checks.reading: the solver is trustworthy for mu_2, so the quadrupole below is the physics of this kernel and not a numerical artefact

checks.name: V3 [HYPOTHESIS CHECK -- a FAIL is the result: does mu_2 clear the Cassini ceiling on any footing at g_ext - 1 sigma?] the exact-AQUAL quadrupole of mu_2 is compared with the Park 2026 two-sigma ceiling
checks.measured: canonical 6.44x ceiling (min 6.18x at g_ext-1sig); alt 7.63x (7.29x); best case 6.18x
checks.reading: stated as a hypothesis so a fail cannot be reworded into a pass. mu_2 has a POWER-LAW approach to Newton (1-mu ~ 4/x^2), gentler than nu_RAR's, so its transition region is broader and its quadrupole LARGER -- the opposite of what an escape needs

checks.name: V4 [mu_2 is at least as excluded as nu_RAR, so selecting mu_2 on rotation curves does not rescue it in the Solar System] the mu_2 quadrupole is compared with nu_RAR's on both footings
checks.reading: the curve the galaxies prefer is MORE excluded in the Solar System than the one they disprefer, because rotation curves reward a gentle transition and Cassini punishes it. That tension is the whole modified-gravity problem, and mu_2 does not resolve it

checks.name: V5 [mu_2 as modified gravity is closed; the surviving sectors are the ones already under constraint] the consequence for the OneFunction's relativistic completion is stated
checks.measured: mu_2 fails Cassini as pure modified gravity (AQUAL/QUMOND) on both footings; as modified inertia it is lensing-dead by the L241 conformal argument; the only escape is a disformal completion (TeVeS/AeST), whose preferred-frame pincer this programme already closed (DC-013/DC-019)
checks.reading: so the OneFunction inherits EXACTLY the non-relativistic pincer that closed nu_RAR: MG fails Cassini, MI fails lensing, disformal is preferred-frame-constrained. The parameter-free curve is an excellent DESCRIPTION of galaxies and does not, by itself, escape the relativistic pincer. This is the honest board
